content: Mago enisole vayaꞌmogi henagaꞌamo afole aisiya afinafeꞌmo kayoꞌmo aliꞌnaya gemae

Ageteꞌnaeꞌmo agovana magoꞌe aune kavafeꞌmo lusi kava huꞌa hapau neꞌaiya agufa aune kavaꞌmo haneꞌniyana seveniꞌa enisole vayaꞌmogi seveniꞌa kayoꞌmo aliꞌnae. Ani kayoꞌmo Gotiꞌa aipamo leno neꞌapateyanageno apamagisigeno hano hugiyaꞌmofeꞌmo henagaꞌamo ani kayoꞌmo afole aisiyafeꞌmo haneꞌniye.

Agovana mago ani kotuꞌmoꞌa kalasigana huno aeno ha neleya ani kotuteꞌmo atamo nelegeꞌna ageꞌnove. Ani ani kotuꞌmo agiꞌnaleꞌmo mago vayaꞌmogimo afela afumo aeꞌa apakasege aune yaꞌmo aeꞌa agasege napa agiꞌamo aeꞌa agasege huꞌa maiꞌnaya vayaꞌmo he tiꞌa maiꞌnae. Gotiꞌa mago alopa gitagana agufa yaꞌmo alino apamiꞌnigeꞌa aliꞌa amagiꞌnae.
Apakaemo Moseseꞌa Goti aliꞌyaꞌamo neꞌaliya vekamo yokemo aikeli sipisipimo yokeꞌamo huꞌnae. Ani yokemo huꞌapaeꞌmo,

content.text: Ala kava neꞌmo kayamufaꞌage Gotigae, Magoꞌe kavaꞌmo nehanageꞌapaeꞌmo hapau neꞌaiye. Apaote vayaꞌaiteꞌmo yagaika neꞌapatana ala kini neꞌapimogae, nehana kavakamo kanale kavaꞌageꞌmo haneꞌnigeka lama ge kavaꞌmo nehane.

O Ala kava nene, huꞌa, kagaikageꞌmo kaote vekamo maiꞌnanaꞌmofeꞌmo ina lagimo kagaefeꞌmo koli osuꞌa kagikaleꞌmo aliꞌa asaga osugae. Kagaemo anonaꞌapilefeꞌmo alagepa huka alika fako huka apateteka neꞌapamina kavakamo ago afole aiꞌniyaꞌmofeꞌmo muki alu nofi vaya alu nofi vayaꞌmogimo eꞌa kaulagaleꞌmo kagaefeꞌmo mono hugae,

content: Hutageꞌnaeꞌmo agovana kokuꞌnapi aote mono nopiꞌmo kitaꞌamo aote aote huno yaki maleꞌnigeꞌapaeꞌmo

seveniꞌa enisole vayaꞌmogimo seveniꞌa kayoꞌmo aliꞌnaya vayaꞌmo aote mono nopatiꞌmo emi eꞌnae. Alagepa kukenamo alave alaveꞌage nehiya kukenamo vailiꞌnaya vayaꞌmogimo hapaifiꞌyaleꞌmo goliletiꞌmo alo huꞌnaya kukenamo vailiꞌnae.

Mago vekamo loleꞌe loleꞌe vayapati vekamoꞌa seveniꞌa goli yuvapamo alino seveniꞌa enisole vayaꞌmo apamiꞌniye. Gotiꞌa maige maige huno maiꞌneno maino hano osuno neꞌmaiya Gotiꞌa aipamo leno neꞌapateya kavaꞌmo yuvapafiꞌmo havaiteꞌniye.

Gotiꞌa ha le konali yaꞌaꞌe ayamufaꞌamoꞌeꞌmo ata legekana huno nelegeno halinaꞌamo ailino aote mono nopiꞌmo haino havai teꞌnigeꞌapaeꞌmo muki vayaꞌamo afaꞌa faleꞌa haiꞌa maime maime oꞌuꞌnisageꞌapaeꞌmo seveniꞌa enisole vayaꞌmogimo seveniꞌa kayotetiꞌmo apamagime apamagime uꞌa apamagiꞌa hano hutesageꞌapaekeꞌmo afaꞌa faleꞌa haigae.
